author: mikaelj

evidence.excerpt: // Default blanket consent for directory creation: the existing suite exercises behavior, not the consent gate. Consent tests opt out with the ... sentinel value. .env("NISSE_ALLOW_DIR_CREATION", "1"); ... if sentinel { command.env_remove(key); } else { command.env(key, value); }

subject: Integration test harness consent default
text: tests/integration/main.rs spawns the nisse binary with NISSE_ALLOW_DIR_CREATION=1 by default and treats one sentinel value in extra_env as an instruction to remove that environment variable, which consent-focused tests use to opt out of blanket consent.
